annotation.summary_en: Website privacy policy and terms of use of Colombia's Chamber of Representatives, covering definitions, user obligations, copyright, privacy and personal data protection under Law 1581 of 2012. Despite the collector title referencing artificial intelligence, the captured text contains no AI or robotics content; likely a mis-captured page.

Website content is owned by the Chamber; personal non-commercial download allowed with attribution
Users must not misuse content or attack the site's systems
Personal data handled per Colombian Law 1581 of 2012
Disputes subject to Colombian courts in Bogotá
